title: Restore default Brave search behavior
description: The installed extension has BRAVE_API_KEY but no PI_SEARCH_BRAVE_FREE_ONLY flag; routing currently fails closed instead of behaving like the previous extension. Default configured Brave to conservative free-mode pacing while preserving explicit metered opt-in.

logs.msg: Default Brave fixed, but review found the same unnecessary global metered opt-in blocks active Gemini/xAI and explicitly selected Exa/Parallel/X. Broaden fix: credentials/active model/provider hint should be sufficient; retain only explicit provider selection and no fallback.
